observations.value:
Replace “make it good” with one explicit completion criterion:

> **Done when:** the artifact demonstrably satisfies the skill’s stated first principles and every required outcome can be verified from the artifact itself; do not stop at a plausible draft.

Change only that criterion—add no extra guidance or duplicated rules.

Then:

1. Blind-run all three cases again, including the previously passing cases, using one fresh, context-free agent per case. Each runner sees only its input and the revised skill.
2. After every run, check the live checkout and clean any leaked changes.
3. Have separate fresh judges grade each artifact against that case’s bar and the skill’s first principles, citing specific evidence.
4. Re-run important or borderline cases 2–3 times and report pass rates.
5. Confirm the failed case now passes without regressions. If any case still fails, diagnose that failure and repeat the minimal revision/re-evaluation loop.
